title: Initial toolbox (core draw tools)
description: Tools panel with MVP subset: Selection (V), Line (N), Oval (O), Rectangle (R), Pencil (Y), Paint Bucket (K), Hand (H), Zoom (Z); stroke/fill color swatches and No Color. Object Drawing toggle (J) for shape tools. See docs/04-toolbox.md, docs/05-color-strokes-fills.md. Depends on vector-engine-mvp, stage-view-mvp.
